doc: Selective colour (Photoshop style): CMYK ink adjustments per colour range. `adjust` = 36 values in -1..1 (UI -100..100 %), range-major then cyan, magenta, yellow, black; ranges in order reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, whites, neutrals, blacks. Range weights of the straight colour (h = HSV hue in degrees, chroma = max - min, mx / mn = max / min channel, L = Rec.709 luma): colour ranges with centres 0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300: w = max(0, 1 - hueDistance / 60) * chroma; whites = smoothstep(0.5, 1, mn); blacks = smoothstep(0.5, 1, 1 - mx); neutrals = (1 - smoothstep(0, 0.25, chroma)) * (1 - |2 L - 1|). Inks C, M, Y = 1 - R, 1 - G, 1 - B, K = min(C, M, Y). For each ink i: i' = i + w * a_i * (relative ? i : 1) summed over the ranges; the black adjustment adds w * a_k * (relative ? K : 1) to all three inks; result 1 - clamp(ink'). `relative` = Photoshop's relative method (changes proportional to the existing ink), off = absolute. The 36 values travel through an 8-bit table (resolution 1/127.5, |value| < 0.5 % is treated as 0). Alpha unchanged.

adjust.unit: -1..1 = -100..100 %, range-major (reds .. blacks) then c, m, y, k
